content: FarmEazy is an on-demand farm machinery rental marketplace for Indian farmers.
The platform connects farmers who need tractors and specialized equipment with machine owners who have idle capacity.
It combines mobile booking, transparent pricing, verified operators, live GPS tracking, community machine pooling, fuel estimation, and AI-assisted crop diagnostics.
Domain: Agri-tech, rural mobility, and agricultural mechanization.
Smallholder farmers face high machinery purchase costs and seasonal labour shortages.
Equipment is often unavailable during critical 7–10 day sowing and harvesting windows.
More than 40% of tractors can remain idle outside peak cycles, while owners lack a reliable demand channel.
Make equipment discovery and booking simple and transparent.
Improve machine utilization and owner income.
Reduce delays through live dispatch visibility and verified operators.
Support shared bookings through community machine pooling.
1. Farmer searches by equipment type, horsepower, attachment, location, and rate.
2. Owner receives the request and confirms availability.
3. Operator dispatches the machine and shares live trip status.
4. Work completion is verified before payment settlement.
Farmer / Owner mobile interface → Node.js + Express REST API → SQLite data layer
Supporting services: authentication, rate limiting, GPS telemetry, fuel estimation, mandi rates, weather alerts, and crop diagnostics.
Vanilla HTML5, responsive CSS, glassmorphism design system, and JavaScript single-page controllers.
Helmet security hardening, session-cookie authentication, and rate limiting.
SQLite with isolated storage, bcrypt credential hashing, and foreign-key role separation.
APMC mandi rates, agro-weather alerts, diesel estimation, and rule-based crop diagnosis.
Confirmed → Accepted → On the Way → Work in Progress → Completed
Live GPS Radar shows tractor position, speed, distance, diesel level, and estimated arrival time.
Farm Pooling groups nearby fields to share mobilization overhead.
Smart Fuel Estimator uses crop, acreage, and soil texture to estimate machine hours and diesel use.
AI Crop Doctor provides rule-based guidance from selected leaf symptoms.
100% verified drivers and field quality checks
FarmEazy addresses the access, utilization, and trust gaps in agricultural mechanization through a two-sided marketplace with operational visibility.
• IoT fuel-tank sensors for anti-theft monitoring
• Hindi, Punjabi, and Haryanvi voice-based booking
• Wider regional rollout through verified machine-owner hubs
